interface.name: zwlr_foreign_toplevel_manager_v1
interface.description:
The purpose of this protocol is to enable the creation of taskbars and docks by providing them with a list of opened applications and letting them request certain actions on them, like maximizing, etc.
After a client binds the zwlr_foreign_toplevel_manager_v1, each opened toplevel window will be sent via the toplevel event.
Clients which only care about the current state can perform a roundtrip after binding this global.
For each instance of this interface, the compositor will create a dedicated zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 object for each opened toplevel. These objects are only used by the one client which created them and are destroyed when the client disconnects.
The compositor may choose to restrict this protocol to a special client launched by the compositor itself, or expose it to all clients, this is compositor policy.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is experimental and backward incompatible changes may be made.

request.name: stop
request.description: Indicates the client no longer wishes to receive events. The compositor should stop sending events and destroy this object.

event.name: toplevel
event.description: This event is emitted whenever a new toplevel window is created. It is emitted for all toplevels, regardless of the app that has created them.

event.name: finished

description.summary: the compositor has finished with the toplevel manager

event.description: This event indicates that the compositor is done sending events to this object. The client should destroy this object.

interface.name: zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1
interface.description:
A zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 object represents an opened toplevel window. Each object has a list of outputs it is visible on, clients can request operations on it and query state.
A toplevel has an app id and title, state flags, and may have a parent. State changes are sent as events and are latched by done.

description.summary: requests that the toplevel be maximized
requests that the toplevel be unmaximized
requests that the toplevel be minimized
requests that the toplevel be unminimized

request.name: activate
request.description: Requests that this toplevel be activated on the given seat.

description.summary: request that the toplevel be closed

request.name: set_rectangle

description.summary: the rectangle which represents the toplevel

request.description: Provides the rectangle of the toplevel in the surface-local coordinates of the wl_surface resource.

event.name: title
event.description: The title of the toplevel has changed.

event.name: app_id
event.description: The app-id of the toplevel has changed.

event.name: output_enter
event.description: The toplevel now enters an output.

event.name: output_leave
event.description: The toplevel no longer is on this output.

event.name: state
event.description: The different states to which the toplevel can be in.

event.name: done

description.summary: all information about the toplevel has been sent

event.description: This event is sent after all changes in the toplevel state have been sent.

event.name: closed
event.description: This event means the toplevel has been destroyed. It is guaranteed no other events will be sent after this one.

event.name: parent
event.description: This event indicates that the parent of this toplevel has changed.
